public_rationale: Anthropic's filing establishes that OpenAI remained a substantial competitor. Bloomberg reported a September run rate near USD 50 billion, but that is an interim observation. No decisive event settles the asserted prerequisite before November 18. Reaching the numerical target would not, by itself, prove that it was necessary to compete.
limitations: Competitive standing has no numerical definition in the claim.
The revenue report relies on unnamed sources describing private communications.
The cited September date does not identify the exact underlying annualization window.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: To compete with Anthropic, OpenAI must reach $60 billion annualized revenue within three months.

statement.excerpt: To compete with Anthropic, it will have to hit $60 billion in annualized revenue (I’m so fucking tired of annualized revenues) within the next three months.

from_speaker: will have to hit $60 billion in annualized revenue
our_interpretation: Three months from August 18 ends on November 18, 2026.
This asserts a prerequisite for competing, not an unconditional promise that OpenAI will reach the threshold.
The ordinary reading of competing is remaining a substantial commercial rival. The speaker supplies no required market share or revenue ratio.

The surrounding reference to OpenAI's own run-rate calculation indicates company-reported annualized revenue. Use its own revenue recognition perimeter consistently, excluding partner sales it does not recognize.
The gross-or-net choice records that revenue perimeter; it does not mean profit.
criteria.support_condition: With substantial commercial rivalry established, OpenAI reaches at least USD 60 billion in comparable company-reported annualized revenue by November 18, and evidence supports the asserted necessity of that threshold. Attainment alone establishes only the numerical component.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI remains a substantial commercial rival after November 18 despite never reaching USD 60 billion in comparable annualized revenue during the specified interval.

evidence.explanation: Anthropic's filing identifies OpenAI as a primary competitor, satisfying the ordinary commercial-rivalry reading of the antecedent. It does not establish that USD 60 billion is necessary.

evidence.explanation: This reports an interim run rate below the threshold, based on unnamed sources. September precedes the deadline and cannot establish a November target miss.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable run-rate records through November 18 and evidence of OpenAI's competitive standing afterward. Continued substantial rivalry without ever reaching the threshold would contradict the prerequisite; support requires evidence of necessity as well as attainment.
